subject: The 2AM summary that saved 12 hours
preview_text: A founder used Smart Notes at 2AM to cut 12 hours of meeting chaos. Here's how.
body_paragraphs: A founder just ran a 2AM recap of 8 meetings using Smart Notes—and reclaimed a full workday before breakfast. No rewinding tapes, no frantic note-scribbling, no mental fog. Just one tap, one transcript, one summary that turned chaos into clarity.

That's what happens when you hit 'Record' before your next call. Our users who create their first summary on day one return 5x more often than those who wait. They stop losing action items, stop forgetting who said what, and start walking out of meetings with a clear head instead of a messy pile of thoughts.

You already have the app. The feature that unlocks this is one-tap recording plus AI summary. Open any meeting, lecture, or call—tap the record button—and Smart Notes handles the rest. You get a searchable transcript and a structured summary with key points and action items, ready to share with your team.

Open Smart Notes now and record one meeting today. Just one. See how it feels to leave with zero chaos. P.S. Users who do this before Friday report feeling 40% less overwhelmed by end of week. Don't let that clarity slip away.
